arxiv-1907-08948.title: Hindi Visual Genome: A Dataset for Multimodal English-to-Hindi Machine Translation
arxiv-1907-08948.creator: Shantipriya Parida, Ondřej Bojar, Satya Ranjan Dash
arxiv-1907-08948.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Shantipriya Parida, Ondřej Bojar, Satya Ranjan Dash. Visual Genome is a dataset connecting structured image information with English language. We present “Hindi Visual Genome”, a multimodal dataset consisting of text and images suitable for English-Hindi multimodal machine translation task and multimodal research. We have selected short English segments (captions) from Visual Genome along with associated images and automatically translated them to Hindi with manual post-editing which took the associated images into account.

arxiv-2108-06157.title: An Enquiry on similarities between Renormalization Group and Auto-Encoders using Transfer Learning.
arxiv-2108-06157.creator: Mohak Shukla, Ajay D. Thakur
arxiv-2108-06157.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mohak Shukla, Ajay D. Thakur. Physicists have had a keen interest in the areas of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) for some time now, with a special inclination towards unravelling the mechanism at the core of the process of learning. In particular, exploring the underlying mathematical structure of a neural net (NN) is expected to not only help us in understanding the epistemological meaning of ‘Learning’ but also has the potential to unravel the secrets behind the workings of the brain.

arxiv-2209-14101.title: First Principles Study of the Electronic Structure of the Ni 2 MnIn/InAs and Ti 2 MnIn/InSb interfaces
arxiv-2209-14101.creator: Brett Heischmidt, Maituo Yu, Derek Dardzinski, James Etheridge, Saeed Moayedpour, Vlad S. Pribiag, Paul A. Crowell, Noa Marom
arxiv-2209-14101.description: Abstract We present a first-principles study of the electronic and magnetic properties of epitaxial interfaces between the Heusler compounds Ti 2 MnIn and Ni 2 MnIn and the III-V semiconductors, InSb and InAs, respectively. We use density functional theory (DFT) with a machine-learned Hubbard U U correction determined by Bayesian optimization.

arxiv-2210-15913.title: GeoGCN: Geometric Dual-domain Graph Convolution Network for Point Cloud Denoising
arxiv-2210-15913.creator: Zhaowei Chen, Peng Li, Zeyong Wei, Honghua Chen, Haoran Xie, Mingqiang Wei, Fu Lee Wang
arxiv-2210-15913.description: Abstract We propose GeoGCN , a novel geometric dual-domain graph convolution network for point cloud denoising (PCD). Beyond the traditional wisdom of PCD, to fully exploit the geometric information of point clouds, we define two kinds of surface normals, one is called Real Normal (RN), and the other is Virtual Normal (VN).

arxiv-2310-10506.creator: Yayu Guo 1 Mejdi Azaïez 1,2 Chuanju Xu 1,3
arxiv-2310-10506.description: Abstract . In this paper, we propose and analyze an efficient numerical method for the anisotropic phase field dendritic crystal growth model, which is challenging because we are facing the nonlinear coupling and anisotropic coefficient in the model. The proposed method is a two-step scheme.

arxiv-2405-04403.title: Learning To See But Forgetting To Follow: Visual Instruction Tuning Makes LLMs More Prone To Jailbreak Attacks
arxiv-2405-04403.description: Abstract Augmenting Large Language Models (LLMs) with image-understanding capabilities has resulted in a boom of high-performing Vision-Language models (VLMs). While studying the alignment of LLMs to human values has received widespread attention, the safety of VLMs has not received the same attention.

arxiv-2406-11275.title: Self-training Large Language Models through Knowledge Detection
arxiv-2406-11275.creator: Wei Jie Yeo, Teddy Ferdinan, Przemyslaw Kazienko, Ranjan Satapathy, Erik Cambria
arxiv-2406-11275.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) often necessitate extensive labeled datasets and training compute to achieve impressive performance across downstream tasks. This paper explores a self-training paradigm, where the LLM autonomously curates its own labels and selectively trains on unknown data samples identified through a reference-free consistency method. Empirical evaluations demonstrate significant improvements in reducing hallucination in generation across multiple subjects.

arxiv-2408-16430.title: Do Recommender Systems Promote Local Music? A Reproducibility Study Using Music Streaming Data
arxiv-2408-16430.creator: Kristina Matrosova, Lilian Marey, Guillaume Salha-Galvan, Thomas Louail, Olivier Bodini, Manuel Moussallam
arxiv-2408-16430.description: Abstract . This paper examines the influence of recommender systems on local music representation, discussing prior findings from an empirical study on the LFM-2b public dataset 1 1 1 Previously available at http://www.cp.jku.at/datasets/LFM-2b/ , the LFM-2b dataset has recently been taken down due to license issues. .

arxiv-2506-21992.title: Explicit construction of states in orbifolds of products of 𝑵 = 𝟐 N=2 Superconformal ADE Minimal models
arxiv-2506-21992.creator: Boris Eremin, Sergej Parkhomenko
arxiv-2506-21992.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Boris Eremin, Sergej Parkhomenko. We generalize the explicit construction of fields in orbifolds of products of N = ( 2 , 2 ) N=(2,2) minimal models, developed by A.Belavin, V.Belavin and S.Parkhomenko to include minimal models with D and E-type modular invariants. It is shown that spectral flow twisting by the elements of admissible group G adm G_{\text{adm}} , which is used in the construction of the orbifold, is consistent with the nondiagonal pairing of D and E-type minimal models.

arxiv-2510-23937.title: Optimized Loudspeaker Panning for Adaptive Sound-Field Correction and Non-stationary Listening Areas
arxiv-2510-23937.creator: Yuancheng Luo
arxiv-2510-23937.description: Abstract \expresspapernumber 65 \correspondence Yuancheng Luoluoyuancheng@gmail.com \lastnames Luo Optimized Loudspeaker Panning {onecolabstract} Surround sound systems commonly distribute loudspeakers along standardized layouts for multichannel audio reproduction. However in less controlled environments, practical layouts vary in loudspeaker quantity, placement, and listening locations / areas. Deviations from standard layouts introduce sound-field errors that degrade acoustic timbre, imaging, and clarity of audio content reproduction.

pmc-10847630.title: A targetable pathway to eliminate TRA-1-60+/TRA-1-81+ chemoresistant cancer cells
pmc-10847630.creator: Lei Tan, Xiaohua Duan, Pratyusha Mutyala, Ting Zhou, Sadaf Amin, Tuo Zhang, Brian Herbst, Gokce Askan, Tomer Itkin, Zhaoying Xiang, Fabrizio Michelassi, Michael D Lieberman, Christine A Iacobuzio-Donahue, Steven D Leach, Todd Evans, Shuibing Chen
pmc-10847630.description: Chemoresistance is a primary cause of treatment failure in pancreatic cancer. Identifying cell surface markers specifically expressed in chemoresistant cancer cells (CCCs) could facilitate targeted therapies to overcome chemoresistance. We performed an antibody-based screen and found that TRA-1-60 and TRA-1-81, two ‘stemness’ cell surface markers, are highly enriched in CCCs. Furthermore, TRA-1-60+/TRA-1-81+ cells are chemoresistant compared to TRA-1-60–/TRA-1-81– cells.

pmc-11499070.title: Using DEXA to diagnose impending atypical femoral fracture in an asymptomatic patient on long term bisphosphonates: A case report of a missed opportunity for fracture prevention
pmc-11499070.creator: Ashraf Amin Ariff, Panagiotis Konstantinou, Michael Cuss, Charmaine Riley Nelson, Ahmed Hamed, Anastasios P. Nikolaides
pmc-11499070.description: Key Clinical MessageWe report a patient who sustained an AFF (Atypical femoral fractures) after 15 years of bisphosphonate treatment. DEXA scans can be utilized to identify early evidence of AFF in asymptomatic patients up to 9 years before the development of an AFF. BACKGROUND/INTRODUCTION Osteoporosis and associated fragility fractures are major contributors to morbidity and mortality globally.

pmc-12555896.title: Evaluation of local council funding for food aid organisations since cost-of-living crisis in the UK
pmc-12555896.creator: R Loopstra, A Sawyer
pmc-12555896.description: BackgroundUse of food aid has risen in the UK over the cost-of-living crisis. Food aid organisations were concerned they would not have sufficient food supplies to meet rising demand. Government funding for the cost-of-living crisis was used by local councils to support food aid organisations.

pmc-12575520.title: Pre-Clinical Models of Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction: Advancing Knowledge for Device Based Therapies
pmc-12575520.creator: Nina Langer, Andreas Escher, Caglar Ozturk, Andrew F. Stephens, Ellen T. Roche, Marcus Granegger, David M. Kaye, Shaun D. Gregory
pmc-12575520.description: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) is a growing health problem worldwide, accounting for half of all heart failure cases. HFpEF patients present with diverse underlying causes and symptoms, making diagnosis and treatment challenging. Current pharmacological therapies are inadequate, while approved device-based therapies have shown limited success due to patient heterogeneity.

pmc-12615714.title: Family health history and pharmacogenomics show cross generation premature amitriptyline discontinuation is associated with CYP2C19 loss of-function enrichment
pmc-12615714.creator: Emma F. Magavern, Gabriel Marengo, Maia Megase, Damian Smedley, Mark J. Caulfield
pmc-12615714.description: BackgroundGenetics influence medication response yet integrating family health history (FHH) of medication response with pharmacogenomics remains underexplored. The objective of this study was to examine cross-generational medication exposure patterns and assess the utility of FHH for medication response using electronic health records.MethodsGenes & Health (G&H) data from Bangladeshi and Pakistani participants were analysed for parent-offspring trios with medication exposure.

pmc-12625959.title: Associations between social determinants of health and COVID-19 outcomes by variants of concern: a Bayesian spatiotemporal analysis
pmc-12625959.creator: Fanyu Xiu, Michael A Irvine, Natalie Prystajecky, Linda Hoang, Linwei Wang, Sharmistha Mishra, Beate Sander, Stefan Baral, Naveed Z Janjua, Hind Sbihi
pmc-12625959.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundSocially and economically disadvantaged populations were disproportionately affected by COVID-19, but it remains unclear whether and how variants of concern moderated the associations between social determinants of health and COVID-19 outcomes.MethodsWe aggregated cases by week and health region (n=231) from 1 January 2021 to 27 February 2022, covering four major variants of concern waves–Alpha, Gamma, Delta and Omicron–in British Columbia, the third most populated province in Canada.

pmc-13248898.title: Minimally invasive surgical management of mid- to distal esophageal diverticula: a large single-center review
pmc-13248898.creator: Marissa A Matto, James D Luketich, Ryan M Levy, Gabriella Lloyd, Omar Awais, Tadeusz Witek, Neil A Christie, Navid Ajabshir, Evan T Alicuben
pmc-13248898.description: Purpose:This study aimed to investigate the outcomes of minimally invasive surgery for mid- to distal thoracic esophageal diverticula (TED).Methods:This was a retrospective review of patients who underwent surgery for symptomatic TED. Patients with Zenker diverticulum were excluded. Demographic information and operative details were recorded.

pmc-13539819.title: An Epidemiological Study of Sleep-Related Disorders and Their Association With Cardiovascular Risk Factors in an Adult Population (30-69 Years) of South Delhi
pmc-13539819.creator: Vishal K Singh, Farzana Islam, Rambha Pathak, Aqsa Shaikh, Srikrishna Sulgodu Ramachandra
pmc-13539819.description: BackgroundSleep-related disorders (SRDs) are a major yet underdiagnosed public health burden in India, and community-level evidence linking them with cardiometabolic risk factors remains scarce. This study aimed to estimate the point prevalence of selected SRDs assessed by four validated screening questionnaires, and to examine their association with cardiovascular risk factors in an urban adult population of South Delhi.

pmc-13577268.title: Functional evidence of Hv1-mediated proton flux in cardiac mitochondria
pmc-13577268.creator: Rayen De Fazio, Clara Ventura, Paulina Finochietto, Ernesto A Aiello, Carolina Jaquenod De Giusti, Verónica Milesi
pmc-13577268.description: Mitochondria are essential for cardiac myocyte function, providing the continuous ATP supply required for contraction and cellular homeostasis. Regulation of the proton motive force, which is critical for ATP synthesis, depends on multiple ion transport mechanisms, including those mediating H+ flux.

uslaw-usc-t38-s1533.title: 38 U.S.C. § 1533 — Children of Civil War veterans
uslaw-usc-t38-s1533.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t38-s1533.description: United States Code, Title 38 (Veterans’ Benefits); Part II (General Benefits); Chapter 15 (Pension For Non-Service-Connected Disability Or Death Or For Service); Subchapter III (Pensions To Surviving Spouses And Children). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whenever there is no surviving spouse entitled to pension under section 1532 of this title, the Secretary shall pay to the children of each Civil War veteran.
